principle: A harness component should earn the context and complexity it consumes. This registry makes that testable rather than assumed.
corpus_note: Ablation and host conformance share one evaluation corpus. Do not add a second benchmark system; extend the suites under evals/ instead.

ablation_methods.remove-catalog-entry: Remove one object from a named collection in a catalog JSON file, in a throwaway copy of the repository. Canonical source files are never modified.
